contain_candidates.note: A reader gets the standard text of al-An'am 6:2–10 laid out as if read from the leaf. The leaf itself is a masked palimpsest whose lower text can barely be made out, so the words, line breaks and any variants can't be checked against the image.

defects.quote: 出焉者國
defects.what: The page reads 出焉耆國, and it belongs to 綠鹽, not 狄鹽. The candidate misreads 耆 as 者 and attaches the phrase to the wrong entry.

defects.quote: 綠鹽水中石下，狀若扁青，為眼藥之要
defects.what: Drops 出焉耆國 and 空青. The page reads 綠鹽出焉耆國水中石下狀若扁青空青為眼藥之要.

defects.quote: 出邯鄲及河東池澤
defects.what: This phrase is part of the 大鹽 entry (本草大鹽出邯鄲及河東池澤), but the candidate places it under 木鹽.

defects.quote: 大鹽一名胡鹽。虞毓《胡鹽賦》：河東有大鹽
defects.what: Invented. The page has 虞龢冀州論河東有大鹽; there is no 虞毓 and no 胡鹽賦 on the page.

defects.quote:
# 胡鹽

《本草》：大鹽一名胡鹽。
defects.what: The 沈約 樂歌 quotation (楚桂胡鹽芼芳卉…) belongs here and has been dropped from this entry.

defects.quote: 《冀州論》：河東有鹵鹽。
defects.what: The 冀州論 citation belongs to 大鹽 and reads 大鹽, not 鹵鹽.

defects.quote: 沈約《樂歌》：楚桂鹵鹽，芼芳卉，加邊列
defects.what: This quotation belongs under 胡鹽, and its repetition mark stands for 胡鹽, not 鹵鹽. 邊 should also read 籩.

defects.quote: 以河鹽為勝
defects.what: The page reads 以河東者為勝.

defects.quote: 蓬鹽生於草，東者為勝
defects.what: 東者為勝 is the end of the 山鹽 entry and does not belong to 蓬鹽.

contain_candidates.note: Several entries are garbled: citations are moved under the wrong headwords (大鹽/胡鹽/鹵鹽/木鹽/蓬鹽), and a 虞毓《胡鹽賦》 that is not on the page has been invented.

defects.quote: 父子尊故馮尸在先
defects.what: The page reads 父母尊, but the candidate has 父子尊.

defects.quote: 君於臣撫之案尸心身不服膺也
defects.what: The page reads 君尊但以手撫案尸心; the candidate replaces it with a repeat of 君於臣撫之.

defects.quote: 盧云賤者垝也
defects.what: The page has 畧, but the candidate reads it as 垝.

defects.quote:
舅姑於婦撫之者<gloss>亦手案尸心</gloss>
<gloss>云尊故捧當心上衣也</gloss>
defects.what: The candidate leaves out 婦於舅姑奉之者盧, scrambles the order of the last two columns, and so attaches the 盧云 comment to the wrong clause.

contain_candidates.note: The last four columns are badly garbled: a phrase is invented, the clause 婦於舅姑奉之 is missing, the commentary is out of order and wrongly tagged as glosses, and there are misreadings such as 父子 for 父母 and 垝 for 畧.

defects.quote: 犀兼訓𤛙
defects.what: page reads 犀兼訓瓠中; a variant character replaces 瓠中
the headword on the page is 犂, marked 【增】; 犛 is a different character

defects.quote: 集韻。無切音。釐
defects.what: the page has 正韻鄰溪切同犁詳後犁字註 here; 集韻…音釐 is invented, and 無切音 and 敎義同 belong to the column above

defects.quote: 正韻。鄰溪切。同。**梨**。
defects.what: drops 詳後犁字註 and the stray 敎義同
the whole preceding entry (headword, then 玉篇同牪) is left out

contain_candidates.note: The main 犀 entry is mostly right, apart from 文 for 又 and a dropped 瓠中. The small entries at the end of the page are wrong: the headword is given as 犛 instead of 犂, one gloss is made up, a whole entry and the 八 stroke marker are missing, and 步 appears where the page has 芳.
